{{Quote|Aawwk!|The thug exclaims as Dass Jennir snaps it's leg|<ref name="DT:BH" />}}
A '''member''' of the [[Kilmaulsi]] [[Species/Legends|species]] was on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] shortly after the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. The Kilmaulsi was associated with a [[Unidentified Chistori thug|member]] of the [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] [[Chistori]] species who was also on the planet and accompanied it to accept a job being offered by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Ember Chankeli]] from the planet [[Telerath/Legends|Telerath]]. Chankeli wanted a [[Musori's gang|gang]] of [[Slavery/Legends|enslavers]] removed from her hometown and had advertised as such in a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] nearby. Upon arriving at the location to take the job, the Chistori and the Kilmaulsi, who were accompanied by several [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidians]], found two competitors for the task, one of whom was the former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Dass Jennir]], with whom the reptile had previously fought over the job. Determined not to be beaten a second time the Chistori and his comrades attacked but were all defeated with relative ease by Jennir and subdued. During the fight Jennir brought his foot down on the Kilmaulsi's leg, causing a loud snapping sound and a squawk. The Kilmaulsi wore [[Color/Legends|purple]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and brown pants during the fight and had green skin and blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="DT:BH" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Kilmaulsi thug first appeared in [[2009]] in ''[[Dark Times: Blue Harvest, Part 2]]'' the second of two mini-issues of the ''[[Star Wars: Dark Times]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series which was designed as an introduction to the [[Star Wars: Dark Times: Blue Harvest|''Blue Harvest'']] story arc. The issue was written by [[Randy Stradley]] under the name Mike Harrison and illustrated by [[Douglas Wheatley]].
